items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: And in fact when people were going to buy Basie's records, they'd hear Lady Day or go and buy records to hear Lester Young, like that.

ctx.x: And how insulting it should be to Basie. But it might have been that in those days, because like overnight, Billie Holiday and Preston was springing ahead, high, so fast. And in fact when people were going to buy Basie's records, they'd hear Lady Day or go and buy records to hear Lester Young, like that. Did you hear Lady Day sing so-and-so? If you heard anything else, it would have been (inaudible). Young.
Now, it might have been in there but to preserve Basie's back in those days.
